// CHAOS-5156: closes a gap codex round r1 on #2292 found (independently
// confirmed against real lizard 1.23.0 before fixing). clikeStateGlobal
// used to accept only `_`/alpha as a function-start first byte, but
// clikeStates.stateGlobal (clike.go, the canonical port) also accepts
// '~' -- the shared preprocessor already glues a bare "~" onto the next
// token ("~" + "Foo" -> "~Foo") for every reader, so the merged token
// was arriving here correctly, just never recognized as a function
// start. Java has no destructor syntax, but lizard's tolerant tokenizer
// (matching this whole package's design) still parses this token shape
// the same way it would for C++. Measured directly against real lizard
// 1.23.0: complexity 2 (base 1 + if).
class C {
    ~Foo() {
        if (x > 0) {
            x = x;
        }
    }
}
